camel_example: aliyun imm GetTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 'FileCompression-2f157087-91df-4fda-8c3e-232407ec00000' --ProjectName immtest --TaskType FileCompression
description_en: Queries the information about a specified asynchronous task. Intelligent Media Management (IMM) supports various asynchronous data processing capabilities, each with its own task creation operation, such as CreateFigureClusteringTask for creating figure clustering tasks and CreateFileCompressionTask for creating file compression tasks. This operation is a general-purpose operation that allows you to query the details of an asynchronous task by task ID and type
description_zh: 该接口用于主动查询指定的异步任务信息。IMM支持多种异步数据处理能力，每种能力有各自创建任务的接口，例如创建人物人脸聚类任务CreateFigureClusteringTask、创建文件压缩任务CreateFileCompressionTask等。本接口为通用接口，可以通过任务ID和类型来查询异步任务的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-task --project-name immtest --task-type FileCompression --task-id FileCompression-2f157087-91df-4fda-8c3e-232407ec00000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTask

parameters.help_en: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the task. For valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743993.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务的类型。取值范围请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743993.html

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task that you want to query. This value is returned when you create the task
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的任务ID，该值在创建任务时作为返回参数
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the original request parameters used to create the task. Valid values:
true
false (default)

This parameter takes effect only for the following task types:

MediaConvert
VideoLabelClassification
FaceClustering
FileCompression
ArchiveFileInspection
FileUncompression
PointCloudCompress
ImageToPDF
StoryCreation
LocationDateClustering
ImageSplicing
FacesSearching

parameters.name: request_definition

schema.description_en: The details of the specified task
schema.description_zh: 查询到指定任务的详细信息

Code.description_en: The error code of the task

EndTime.description_en: The time when the task ended. The value is a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format with millisecond precision
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间。格式为：ISO 8601 UTC 时间戳（毫秒级精度）

Message.description_en: The error message of the task
Message.example: The specified resource project is not found.

Progress.description_en:
The task progress. Valid values: 0 to 100. Unit: percent (%).

The GetTask operation does not support this parameter.
This parameter is meaningful only when the task status `State` is `Running`
Progress.description_zh:
任务进度。取值范围为0~100，单位为百分比（%）。

目前GetTask接口暂不支持该参数。
该参数仅在任务运行状态`State`为`Running`时有意义

StartTime.description_en: The time when the task started. The value is a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format with millisecond precision
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间。格式为：ISO 8601 UTC 时间戳（毫秒级精度）

Status.description_en:
The running status of the task. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.

Succeeded: The task is completed.

Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务运行状态。取值范围如下：

Running：任务运行中。

Succeeded：任务执行完成，成功。

Failed：任务执行完成，失败

Tags.description_en: The task tags. These are the tags that the user passed in when creating the task
Tags.description_zh: 任务标签。用户在创建任务时传入的“Tag”标签

TaskRequestDefinition.description_en: The original request parameters used to create the task
TaskRequestDefinition.description_zh: 创建任务的初始请求参数

TaskType.description_en: The type of the task. For valid values, see [Task type list]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743993.html）
TaskType.description_zh: 任务的类型。取值范围请参见[任务类型列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743993.html）

UserData.description_en: The custom information specified by the user
